verdict.rationale: n8n's own docs and repo describe a visual canvas for building multi-step workflows, with 1500+ integrations and thousands of templates. A hands-on report says a manager with zero programming skills built a complex backend with scheduled and webhook-triggered tasks. However, the 'without writing code' part is only partly delivered: users report that non-programmers hit data-transformation errors and may need to write SQL or parse JSON and XML, and the vendor itself pairs visual building with code. missing for 10: first-party documentation that common ops workflows can be completed entirely without code, documented no-code data-transformation tooling, consistent independent corroboration that non-programmers can build workflows without code.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build multi-step workflows in a visual editor without writing code

citations.quote: Combine a visual canvas with custom code, run it self-hosted or in the cloud, and connect to 1500+ integrations.
Build and operationalize AI workflows and multi-step agents using your own data, models, and tools
Our manager with zero programming skills was able to build a quite complex backend using postgres and REST APIs, with scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks.
I think it's great for less-technical users when compared to windmill.
